answer: One defence is Registered postal worker appointment with postal service attestation: an appointment the service renews after round audits, and the glacier of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the raven is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the garden of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
